evals.name: go-done
evals.expected_output: Runs repo Makefile lint/test targets plus gofmt, go fix until clean, go vet; reports each check as passed, failed, or not run; verdict line with remaining items.

evals.name: release-ready
evals.expected_output: Flags uncommitted file and appVersion mismatch; confirms tag absence; lists fmt, clippy, test, coverage; verdict not ready with numbered items.

evals.name: toolchain-bump
evals.expected_output: Skips the local lint loop for a toolchain-only bump and keeps the artifact version unchanged.
